# Improving the lives of the people we touch

Convatec is a global medical products and technologies company focused on therapies for the
management of chronic conditions, leading in advanced wound care, stoma care, continence and
critical care, and infusion devices.
[ Learn about us ][223]

## Forever Caring

Living with a condition, no matter how long or short it may be, is a journey. One that will be
different for everyone. That can feel unpredictable and unfair. And at times even life changing. But
we believe it never needs to be YOU changing. That you deserve better, holistic care. So, you can
keep being you.



[Stoma Care] ;

### Stoma Care

Information, support and advice on post operative lifestyle for ileostomy, urostomy, colostomy and
general stoma care patients.
[Read more][224] [Advanced Wound Care] ;

### Advanced Wound Care

Leading the way in advanced wound and skin care innovation. Learn more about all our high quality
products to help heal wounds faster.
[Read more][225]




## Healthy Bonds. Our bonds determine who we are.

;

There’s no bond more important than the one with your own body. Convatec helps you create a healthy
bond with yourself, your stoma. And then, with the world around you.

Start creating a healthy bond with your stoma by finding the answers you need quickly with me+
Answers.

The me+™ programme offers you the right support so you feel stronger, more confident and ready for
what’s ahead. The ostomy products and support you need, tips and advice for stoma care, and a
community you can grow with. Have questions about living with an stoma? Our me+ specialists and
stoma nurses are waiting to help you, call 18002674989 or write to us at
customerserviceindia@convatec.com

[ Join me+ today ][226]

## Feature Highlight: AWC, CC, + Flexi-Seal

Hydrofiber® Technology

### Our Hydrofiber® Technology

**Hydrofiber^{®} Technology is a soft, absorbent material that transforms into a gel on contact with
wound fluid.**

For more than 25 years, Convatec has been helping clinicians to improve patient outcomes, enabling
patients to move on with their lives through the use of Hydrofiber^{®} Technology – globally proven
and trusted. Discover how the unique, innovative Hydrofiber^{®} Technology can help you make a real
impact on the lives of people living with a wound.

Our Hydrofiber® Technology Learn more

[ Learn more ][227] [three doctors] ; Flexi-Seal™

### Flexi-Seal™ FMS

Flexi-Seal™ Fecal Management System (FMS) is an indwelling fecal management catheter intended for
use to manage fecal incontinence through the collection of liquid to semi-liquid stool and to
provide access to administer medications.

Flexi-Seal™ FMS Learn more

[ Learn more ][228] [Flexi-Seal™ FMS] ;

## Sign up and be the first to know about our exciting innovations.

Learning how to live fully with a condition takes education, resources and support. And with me+, we
make sure you don’t have to figure it out alone. Getting the benefits of me+ is easy. Join today for
complete support.

# Improving the lives of the people we touch

Convatec is a global medical products and technologies company focused on therapies for the
management of chronic conditions, leading in advanced wound care, stoma care, continence and
critical care, and infusion devices.
[ Learn about us ][223]

## Forever Caring

Living with a condition, no matter how long or short it may be, is a journey. One that will be
different for everyone. That can feel unpredictable and unfair. And at times even life changing. But
we believe it never needs to be YOU changing. That you deserve better, holistic care. So, you can
keep being you.



[Stoma Care] ;

### Stoma Care

Information, support and advice on post operative lifestyle for ileostomy, urostomy, colostomy and
general stoma care patients.
[Read more][224] [Advanced Wound Care] ;

### Advanced Wound Care

Leading the way in advanced wound and skin care innovation. Learn more about all our high quality
products to help heal wounds faster.
[Read more][225]




## Healthy Bonds. Our bonds determine who we are.

;

There’s no bond more important than the one with your own body. Convatec helps you create a healthy
bond with yourself, your stoma. And then, with the world around you.

Start creating a healthy bond with your stoma by finding the answers you need quickly with me+
Answers.

The me+™ programme offers you the right support so you feel stronger, more confident and ready for
what’s ahead. The ostomy products and support you need, tips and advice for stoma care, and a
community you can grow with. Have questions about living with an stoma? Our me+ specialists and
stoma nurses are waiting to help you, call 18002674989 or write to us at
customerserviceindia@convatec.com

[ Join me+ today ][226]

## Feature Highlight: AWC, CC, + Flexi-Seal

Hydrofiber® Technology

### Our Hydrofiber® Technology

**Hydrofiber^{®} Technology is a soft, absorbent material that transforms into a gel on contact with
wound fluid.**

For more than 25 years, Convatec has been helping clinicians to improve patient outcomes, enabling
patients to move on with their lives through the use of Hydrofiber^{®} Technology – globally proven
and trusted. Discover how the unique, innovative Hydrofiber^{®} Technology can help you make a real
impact on the lives of people living with a wound.

Our Hydrofiber® Technology Learn more

[ Learn more ][227] [three doctors] ; Flexi-Seal™

### Flexi-Seal™ FMS

Flexi-Seal™ Fecal Management System (FMS) is an indwelling fecal management catheter intended for
use to manage fecal incontinence through the collection of liquid to semi-liquid stool and to
provide access to administer medications.

Flexi-Seal™ FMS Learn more

[ Learn more ][228] [Flexi-Seal™ FMS] ;

## Sign up and be the first to know about our exciting innovations.

Learning how to live fully with a condition takes education, resources and support. And with me+, we
make sure you don’t have to figure it out alone. Getting the benefits of me+ is easy. Join today for
complete support.

[ Learn more ][229]

medicines of tomorrow. Healthcare areas include: Oncology, Immunology, Neuroscience and
Cardiopulmonary.

# We’re tackling the world’s toughest health challenges

[ Medicines & therapies ][166]
Johnson & Johnson Innovative Medicine is leading where medicine is going. Patients inform and
inspire our science-based innovations, which continue to change and save lives. With rigorous
science and compassion, we confidently address the most complex diseases of our time and unlock the
medicines of tomorrow. Healthcare areas include: Oncology, Immunology, Neuroscience and
Cardiopulmonary.
[ Oncology ][167]
[ Immunology ][168]
[ Neuroscience ][169]
[ Cardiopulmonary ][170]
[ Learn more ][171]
[ Medical devices & technology ][172]
Johnson & Johnson MedTech innovates at the intersection of biology and technology. With a focus on
treating with pinpoint precision in the hardest-to-reach parts of the body, restoring anatomy and
reimagining healing, our portfolio of smarter, less invasive, more personalized treatments is
addressing the most complex health challenges. Healthcare areas include: Cardiovascular,
Orthopaedics, Surgery and Vision.

Engineering the

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Learn more ][178]

## Medtronic Global Diabetes Capability Center

Engineering technology that simplifies diabetes care

#### ALLEVYN^{◊} LIFE Foam Dressings

In a climate of growing expectations and budget restrictions,^{1-3} ALLEVYN LIFE Dressings may help
improve efficiency and patient satisfaction in community wound care,^{*4-7 }and have been shown to
support pressure injury prevention protocols^{8,9}
[ View product ][80]
[REGENETEN implant on RCR image from animation]

#### REGENETEN^{◊} Bioinductive Implant

Bioinductive collagen scaffold for tendon repair.^{1-3} Resorbed and replaced by new tendon-like
tissue within 6 months to support tendon healing.1,2,4-8
[ View product ][81]
[Hero 1 CORI Surgical System.png]

#### CORI^{◊} Surgical System

Combine your skill with handheld robotics and digital surgery applications across a range of joint
arthroplasty indications. Experience the power of one platform.
[ View product ][82]
[Tula Tympanostomy Kit]

#### Tula^{®} Tympanostomy System

An in-office alternative to traditional tympanostomy using a revolutionary, local anesthesia system
and an automated, 1-click tube delivery device.^{1,2}
[ View product ][83]
[Close up of EDGE, front]

#### RENASYS^{◊} EDGE Negative Pressure Wound Therapy System

The latest evolution in powerful RENASYS tNPWT features an improved user interface for enhanced
intuitiveness and simplicity, with a durable pump built to offer maintenance-free use^{*1-3}
[ View product ][84]
[41813 CARTIHEAL Product Page Hero Image V2]

#### CARTIHEAL^{◊} AGILI-C^{◊} Cartilage Repair Implant

A single-stage, off-the-shelf solution for knee cartilage and osteochondral defects, with or without
mild to moderate osteoarthritis (KL 0-3) comprised of a proprietary biomaterial that is porous and
biocompatible.
[ View product ][85]
[JOURNEYII_BCS_ROX_RoundPatella_AngledView_onWhite.png]

#### JOURNEY II^{◊} ROX^{◊} Total Knee Solution with CONCELOC^{◊} and OXINIUM^{◊} Technologies

Combining cemented and cementless technologies for a reverse hybrid approach, we bring to the stage
our latest and greatest in joint reconstruction
[ View product ][86]
[COR22-33747-V1-ProjectsAlchemy-AirwayMgmt-Hero-1122.png]

#### COBLATION^{◊} Technology for Airway Management

Designed for precise tissue removal^{1-5 }with a low thermal profile⁶
[ View product ][87]

## Wound Care

Smith+Nephew's Wound Care (Advanced Wound Management) portfolio provides comprehensive solutions to
meet broad and complex clinical needs and to help healthcare professionals reduce the human and
economic consequences of wounds.

[GettyImages-1448442087-CUT-OUT-SHAPE.png]

### Wound care indications

Acute, chronic and surgical wound indications, covering key considerations and common aetiologies
(such as inflammation, trauma or vascular deficiency) to help you build a treatment or prevention
plan to restore tissue integrity, reduce complications and promote healing.

[ View all ][88]

### Wound care products

A range of wound care products for targeted intervention on acute, chronic and surgical wounds based
on your patient’s needs and clinical strategy. Solutions range from core products for exudate
management and compression, through to advanced therapies for non-healing wounds and prevention of
infection via antimicrobial barriers.

[ View all ][89]

## Sports Medicine

From elite athletes to weekend warriors, everyone wants to get back to doing what they love after a
sporting injury. With our leading-edge technology, we help patients get back to living a Life
Unlimited.

[ Explore sports medicine ][90]
[Homepage Sports Medicine business unit teaser]

replace diseased, damaged or worn joints, robotics-assisted and enabling technologies, and services
that empower surgeons. It also includes trauma products used to stabilise severe fractures and
correct bone deformities.

# Business Journals

Allied Business Academies publishing a total of 14 different [journals][34] in various fields of
business. With an acceptance rate of 30%, each of the journals of our affiliates is double blind,
peer reviewed and each is listed in SCOPUS, SCIMAGO, Google Scholar, EBSCO, ProQuest, Cengage Gale,
LexisNexis and several other academic databases and search engines. These journals are
simultaneously published in hard copy and online.

## Journals

*[Journal of the International Academy for Case Studies (JIACS)][35]*
  Classroom teaching cases, with Instructor's Notes, on subjects which are taught in Business
  Schools. These cases can be Library or Field based, or Illustrative, but all must be accompanied
  by Instructor's Notes
*[Academy of Entrepreneurship Journal (AEJ)][36]*
  Theoretical and empirical works in Entrepreneurship
*[International Journal of Entrepreneurship (IJE)][37]*
  Theoretical or empirical works in International Entrepreneurship or entrepreneurship in
  international settings
*[Journal of Entrepreneurship Education (JEE)][38]*
  Theoretical, empirical or applied research or educational or case studies in Entrepreneurship
  Education
*[Academy of Accounting and Financial Studies Journal (AAFSJ)][39]*
  Theoretical or empirical works in Accounting or Finance
*[Academy of Educational Leadership Journal (AELJ)][40]*
  Any study involving education, except economic or entrepreneurship education.
*[Journal of Economics and Economic Education Research (JEEER)][41]*
  Theoretical, empirical, applied, or qualitative research and educational or case studies into
  economics or economic education
*[Journal of International Business Research (JIBR)][42]*
  Theoretical or empirical works in International Business or studies of businesses or business
  issues located in international venues
*[Academy of Strategic Management Journal (ASMJ)][43]*
  Theoretical or empirical works in Management, Strategic Management or Leadership
*[Academy of Marketing Studies Journal (AMSJ)][44]*
  Theoretical and empirical works in Marketing
*[Journal of Management Information and Decision Sciences (JMIDS)][45]*
  Theoretical or empirical works in information systems or decision sciences
*[Business Studies Journal (BSJ)][46]*
  Qualitative research in business and business issues
*[Journal of Legal, Ethical and Regulatory Issues (JLERI)][47]*
  Theoretical or empirical works in Business Law, Ethics or Governmental or Regulatory Issues
*[Journal of Organizational Culture, Communications and Conflict (JOCCC)][48]*
  Theoretical or empirical works in Organizational Culture, Communications, Conflict Resolution,
  Organizational Behavior, or Human Resources

### Who Are We?

We are an association of scholars, whose purpose is to support and encourage research and the
sharing and exchange of ideas, knowledge and insights throughout the world.

### Who Are Our Members?

The members of our affiliates are primarily teaching professors in business schools from around the
world who lack research support staff and relief time. It is our special mission to serve this
faculty. Come join us and let us show you the powerful and compelling research that such professors
produce.

Allied Business Academies publishing a total of 14 different journals in various fields of business.
With an acceptance rate of 30%, each of the journals of our affiliates is double blind, peer
reviewed and some of the journals are listed in SCOPUS, SCIMAGO, Google Scholar, ProQuest, Cengage
Gale, LexisNexis and several other academic databases and search engines.

  Theoretical or empirical works in International Entrepreneurship or entrepreneurship in
  international settings
*[Journal of Entrepreneurship Education (JEE)][38]*
  Theoretical, empirical or applied research or educational or case studies in Entrepreneurship
  Education

*[Journal of Economics and Economic Education Research (JEEER)][41]*
  Theoretical, empirical, applied, or qualitative research and educational or case studies into
  economics or economic education
*[Journal of International Business Research (JIBR)][42]*
  Theoretical or empirical works in International Business or studies of businesses or business
  issues located in international venues
*[Academy of Strategic Management Journal (ASMJ)][43]*
  Theoretical or empirical works in Management, Strategic Management or Leadership
*[Academy of Marketing Studies Journal (AMSJ)][44]*
  Theoretical and empirical works in Marketing
*[Journal of Management Information and Decision Sciences (JMIDS)][45]*
  Theoretical or empirical works in information systems or decision sciences
*[Business Studies Journal (BSJ)][46]*
  Qualitative research in business and business issues
*[Journal of Legal, Ethical and Regulatory Issues (JLERI)][47]*
  Theoretical or empirical works in Business Law, Ethics or Governmental or Regulatory Issues
*[Journal of Organizational Culture, Communications and Conflict (JOCCC)][48]*
  Theoretical or empirical works in Organizational Culture, Communications, Conflict Resolution,
  Organizational Behavior, or Human Resources

## **Global Employee Benefit Programs**

Best in class global and local employee benefit programs for multinational corporations 

### **[Multinational
### Pooling][113]**
###  
###  
###  

Consolidates local employee benefit plans from two or more countries into one account (pool) to
assess the overall global result, enabling the client to receive a potential international
dividend.   

### **[Global
### Underwriting][114]**
###  
###  
###  

Based on the portfolio assessment, it replaces local pricing with global underwriting. This results
in more stable prices and better terms and conditions.

### **[ Captive
### Reinsurance][115]**
###  
###  
###  

Combines employee benefit plans from multiple countries into a corporate’s own captive via a
reinsurance mechanism allowing the company to manage its own risks. This program offers a
personalized online portal, providing access to high quality data analytics, insights and reporting.

### **[ Global
### Pension][116]**
###  
###  
###  

A central coordination of local solutions that helps multinational companies to increase governance
and efficiency across defined contribution (DC) plan and legacy defined benefit (DB) retirement
plans.

## **What is global coverage health insurance?**

Global coverage health insurance is an international health insurance plan designed to provide
medical coverage for individuals living, working, or travelling abroad for extended periods. It
typically includes services like hospitalization, out-patient care, vaccinations, surgeries,
emergency evacuation, diagnostic tests and more.

## **How much does global health insurance cost?**

The cost of global health insurance varies based on factors such as number of members included in
the policy, destination countries, coverage level, pre-existing conditions and medical history (for
individual and small groups). Please [get in touch][132] with our sales team for a detailed quote.

###

###  
###  
###

###  
###

Global coverage health insurance is an international health insurance plan designed to provide
medical coverage for individuals living, working, or travelling abroad for extended periods. It
typically includes services like hospitalization, out-patient care, vaccinations, surgeries,
emergency evacuation, diagnostic tests and more.

the policy, destination countries, coverage level, pre-existing conditions and medical history (for
individual and small groups). Please [get in touch][132] with our sales team for a detailed quote.

#### 23 Years **Experience**

Established in 2020 with 18 years of background. We are the manufacturer and international supplier
of disposable medical items.

#### Global **Reach**

We are currently exporting to 36 countries across 6 continents, including USA, Germany, Brazil, UK,
Spain, and to many more global partners.

#### Quality & **Comfort**

 GDLS BRAND FILM

**We Serve Those Who Protect What Matters.**

A trusted partner of forces around the world, we deliver with agility, innovation and exceptional
customer support. Every day, our global team forges ahead into the next era of combat capability,
including autonomy-ready platforms, modern digital architecture and AI-enabled advantages.

That’s why Soldiers and Marines have trusted General Dynamics Land Systems products in the toughest
conditions for decades. We deliver the power to win.

[ Learn More ][36]

### ABOUT GDLS

General Dynamics Land Systems builds the combat vehicles and integrated technologies that give
soldiers a decisive advantage. We design, engineer and sustain advanced tracked and wheeled systems
paired with modern electronic architecture, AI-enabled capabilities and autonomy-ready technology.

From Abrams to LAV, Stryker to AJAX, robotic platforms to software solutions and beyond, our
portfolio delivers proven performance and future-ready modernization for customers around the world.

### Not a career.
### A calling.

Join the people who design, build and advance the systems that protect those who protect us. Our
teams see beyond the horizon, solving problems before they become challenges.

Bring your talent. Bring your purpose.

Let’s shape the future of General Dynamics Land Systems together.

## Medical Marketing with Surgical Training Solutions Empower Medical Device Sales

Welcome to Ghost Medical Marketing + Training Solutions, a division of Ghost Productions. Our
mission is to explain medicine and its benefits to humanity through our [medical illustrations][88],
[animations][89], [virtual reality surgery simulations][90], [medical websites][91], and
[interactive software][92]. As a leading provider of medical visualizations and educational tools,
we help healthcare professionals and patients stay informed and up-to-date on the latest medical
developments. Healthcare providers, marketers, and educators use our products for surgical training,
medical marketing, device sales, and patient education. As a result, we work with medical device
manufacturers, pharmaceutical companies, hospitals, and medical schools.

[Our team][93] of experienced professionals uses the latest techniques and technologies to bring
complex medical concepts to life in an engaging and easy-to-understand way. For example, our [VR
surgery simulations][94] provide a realistic, hands-on training experience for surgeons, helping
them to improve their skills and techniques. Our [interactive software][95] and [medical
websites][96] are designed to be user-friendly and provide a valuable resource for both healthcare
professionals and patients. Furthermore, at Ghost Medical, we believe in the power of visual
communication to improve patient care and education. [Contact us][97] today to learn more about how
we can support you in achieving your goals.

## Medical Device Sales and Surgical Training Solutions

We develop highly functional [medical animations][98] and [VR surgical simulators][99] to
effectively train surgeons and physicians, help surgical device companies and pharmaceutical drug
manufacturers market their products and educate patients about their healthcare treatment options.

## Medical Marketing with Surgical Training Solutions Empower Medical Device Sales

Welcome to Ghost Medical Marketing + Training Solutions, a division of Ghost Productions. Our
mission is to explain medicine and its benefits to humanity through our [medical illustrations][88],
[animations][89], [virtual reality surgery simulations][90], [medical websites][91], and
[interactive software][92]. As a leading provider of medical visualizations and educational tools,
we help healthcare professionals and patients stay informed and up-to-date on the latest medical
developments. Healthcare providers, marketers, and educators use our products for surgical training,
medical marketing, device sales, and patient education. As a result, we work with medical device
manufacturers, pharmaceutical companies, hospitals, and medical schools.

[Our team][93] of experienced professionals uses the latest techniques and technologies to bring
complex medical concepts to life in an engaging and easy-to-understand way. For example, our [VR
surgery simulations][94] provide a realistic, hands-on training experience for surgeons, helping
them to improve their skills and techniques. Our [interactive software][95] and [medical
websites][96] are designed to be user-friendly and provide a valuable resource for both healthcare
professionals and patients. Furthermore, at Ghost Medical, we believe in the power of visual
communication to improve patient care and education. [Contact us][97] today to learn more about how
we can support you in achieving your goals.

### Grounded in Innovation. Powered by Collaboration.

At Hemostasis, LLC, we partner with leading physicians to develop innovative technologies designed
to optimize usability and efficacy, to improve patient outcomes and enhance overall patient care. We
strive to continuously innovate and improve.

### PosiSep® X

Constructed from our proprietary NOCC chitosan polymer technology, the PosiSep® X hemostat
dressing/intranasal splint provides both superior performance and patient comfort. PosiSep® X is
ultra-unique in its placement, ability to conform to any sinus anatomy, its performance, and even in
the way it is most easily removed.

[Learn More][45]
[Technologies Icon]

### Our Technologies

One of Hemostasis’ core technologies is a naturally occurring polysaccharide derivative of
deacetylated chitin, Chitosan. Chitosan is derived from chitin using various methods of proprietary
processes in order to obtain the desired degree of deacetylation and molecular weight.

*[Learn more about our Chitosan technology][46]*

[Products Icon]

### Our Products

Along with a variety of bleeding control and wound healing technologies, Hemostasis is a leading
manufacturer of the groundbreaking product PosiSep® brands of sinus spacer/hemostat technologies
within the ENT space.   Our PosiSep® X comes as a firm sponge and expands after placement in the
sinus cavity and hydration with saline and provides longer term separation (7-10 days) while our
PosiSep® hemostat spacer provides a faster dissolving, faster clearing product with 2-3 days of
tissue separation.

[*Learn more about our products*][47]

What home healthcare services does Homely Hands provide in Gurgaon?+
We provide trained attendant services, home ICU setup, medical equipment rental (oxygen
concentrators, hospital beds, suction units), senior citizen caretaking, elderly care, and 24/7
clinical nursing across all prime Gurgaon sectors — DLF, Golf Course Road, Sohna Road, Sushant Lok,
and Nirvana Country.
Which areas of Gurgaon do you cover?+
We cover all prime Gurgaon sectors including DLF Phase 1–5, Golf Course Road, Sohna Road, Sushant
Lok, Nirvana Country, MG Road, Sector 40–57, Palam Vihar, Manesar, and all surrounding Gurgaon
areas. Contact us to confirm same-day availability in your specific location.
How quickly can home care be arranged in Gurgaon?+
In most Gurgaon areas, we arrange a qualified home care professional within 4 to 12 hours. For
urgent same-day needs — including post-discharge ICU and nursing care — call us directly at +91
9911982450. Our team responds immediately and deploys caregivers as quickly as possible across all
Gurgaon sectors.
Are your nurses and attendants background-verified?+
Yes. Every nurse, attendant, and caretaker at Homely Hands undergoes rigorous background checks
including police verification, medical credential verification, and regular performance reviews
before deployment. We maintain the highest standards of staff verification to ensure complete safety
for Gurgaon families.
How much does home healthcare cost in Gurgaon?+
Home healthcare with Homely Hands typically costs 60–70% less than equivalent hospital or nursing
facility care in Gurgaon. Costs depend on the type of service, care hours, and duration required. We
offer flexible daily, weekly, and monthly plans. Call us at +91 9911982450 for a personalised quote
for your specific needs.

## Learn more about some common conditions that may occur

Scroll to learn more about the conditions

[Smiling lady leaning against building]

## Presbyopia

Presbyopia is a decreased ability to see nearby objects, especially in low light. Everyone will
become presbyopic, usually starting around the age of 40; however, laser vision correction offers a
treatment option for this condition.

[Cheerful bearded Black man smiling outside]

## Astigmatism

Astigmatism is a variation in the curvature of the cornea or in the shape of the eye's lens.
Astigmatism results in blurred or distorted vision at all distances. [Laser vision correction][14]
can address astigmatism.

[Older woman looking at the sea during sunrise]

## Dry Eye

Dry Eye is a condition in which a person does not have enough quality tears to lubricate and nourish
the eye. Dry Eye is a common problem, particularly in older adults. Treatment for dry eye symptoms
can help before [cataract][15] or [laser vision correction][16] procedures.

[Older gray haired black man sitting by a window in front of a bookshelf]

## Cataracts

[Cataracts][17] occur when the normally clear lens of the eye becomes cloudy. As aging occurs,
protein from the lens clumps together, causing blurring, clouding, and discoloration of the lens.
Cataracts are the #1 cause of preventable blindness.¹

## For Providers

Explore a curated collection of helpful resources and tools for medical professionals

### Institutes & Departments

Connect with expert teams across our [Institutes and Departments][91] to collaborate on patient care
and drive better outcomes.

### Join Our Nursing Team

Whether you’re just graduating from nursing school or have years of experience, you can build an
exceptional career in [nursing at Cleveland Clinic][92].

### Careers

As one of the nation’s — and the world’s — leading academic medical centers, you can grow in a
setting where you’ll make a difference. [Find your career][93] at Cleveland Clinic.

### Refer a Patient

We welcome the opportunity to partner with you in caring for your patients. Our dedicated [Referring
Physician team][94] is available from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. EST every day for you and your patients.

### ConsultQD

A [site for physicians and healthcare professionals][95] from Cleveland Clinic. Discover the latest
research insights, innovations and treatment trends.

### Education

We’re dedicated to training the next generation of healthcare professionals. Explore the [training
and education programs][96] we offer worldwide.

We’re committed to improving care and finding tomorrow’s cures. Learn about our [cutting-edge basic,
translational and clinical research][97].

If you have symptoms of [cyclospora][46], start with an [Express Care Virtual Visit][47]. You can
also contact your primary care provider or go to one of our Express Cares or Urgent Cares. Learn
when emergency care is appropriate.

[Where to get care][48]
[Person sitting on a couch looking at their mobile phone.]

## Not Sure Where To Go for Care?

We’ll help you choose the right place for your symptoms — from virtual visits and primary care to
Express Care or the ER.

[Get started][49]

[patient centered care icon]

### Patient-centered care:

We don’t just care for your health conditions. We care about you. That means [our providers][65]
take the time to listen to what’s important to you before recommending next steps.

[national recognition icon]

### National recognition:

Cleveland Clinic is recognized in the U.S. and throughout the world for its expertise and care.

[skilled and collaborative providers icon]

### Collaborative providers:

You’ll get care from board-certified and fellowship trained experts who work together to create a
treatment plan just for you. Only the highest standards ensure [excellent outcomes][66].

[Innovation and Research Icon]

### Innovation and research:

We’re focused on today — and tomorrow. Our focus on [research][67] and offering the latest options
means you can find a wide range of [clinical trials][68] and other care that you can’t find
elsewhere.

# Enjoy the Best Views in Austin from Mount Bonnell

#### From Mount Bonnell, the high point Austin TX, you have awesome views on Austin, the Colorado
#### River and the Texas Hill Country

[ Visit Mount Bonnell ][23]
 

### What to Do at Mount Bonnell

At the peak you will find Covert Park, an Austin view point with 360-degree views that include the
city skyline and Lake Austin. This free Austin Mount Bonnell experience attracts locals and tourists
from around the world and offers a variety of activities. There are plenty of nearby Lake Austin
hotels and luxury hotels in Austin to provide you with a memorable stay.

[ 10 Reasons to Visit Austin Mt Bonnell ][24]

## About Mount Bonnell

Bonnell Mountain is a great landmark and one of the most visited sites and tourist attractions in
Austin. The limestone height stands at 775 ft above sea level and is considered to be the highest
point within Austin City Limits. It has been a popular sightseeing destination since the mid-19th
century and continues to attract tourists and locals for mountain biking, hiking, and more on the
Mount Bonnel hiking trail. In fact, it’s a favorite for mountain bikers and a Mount Bonell hike is
on the bucket list of many tourists. Mount Bonnell also known as Covert Park belongs, next to other
parks such as Mueller Lake Park and Zilker Park, to the best parks in Austin.

Visit Mt. Bonnell Austin TX and Covert Park at Mount Bonnell trails and enjoy the beauty of the
Austin skyline. If you want to learn more, you can also buy one of many topographic maps with
elevation data and Austin TX Mount Bonnell directions. So, when tourists arrive and ask: Are there
mountains in Austin, Texas? You can tell them to get ready for an exciting walk on the Mt Bonell
stairs to the top. While you’re visiting Bonnell Austin, don’t forget to take in [Circuit of
Americas][25] Austin TX, the country’s premier destination for phenomenal motorsports and live
entertainment. If you’re a diehard sports fan, check out 104.9 The Horn Austin, it’s a local Austin
radio station with station broadcasts in sports format and is the flagship station of the Texas
Longhorns. If My Bonnell has given you an appetite for heights take a trip out to Texas Hill Country
to see the rural countryside of Central Texas with its rugged hills and native vegetation.

If you’re looking for accommodation, you’ll be spoilt for choice, from family hotels to five star
hotels in Austin. [Hotel Saint Cecilia][26] in Austin and [The Loren at Lady Bird Lake][27] both
offer upscale accommodations where you can recover after sightseeing in two of the best Austin
luxury hotels.

[ About Mount Bonnell ][28]

Check out our gallery page with beautiful photos of Mount Bonn that other visitors have shared. Why
not share your own favorite pic featuring Mount Bonnell for the chance to win a cool t-shirt?

#### River and the Texas Hill Country

[ Visit Mount Bonnell ][23]
 

### What to Do at Mount Bonnell

At the peak you will find Covert Park, an Austin view point with 360-degree views that include the
city skyline and Lake Austin. This free Austin Mount Bonnell experience attracts locals and tourists
from around the world and offers a variety of activities. There are plenty of nearby Lake Austin
hotels and luxury hotels in Austin to provide you with a memorable stay.

[ 10 Reasons to Visit Austin Mt Bonnell ][24]

## About Mount Bonnell

Bonnell Mountain is a great landmark and one of the most visited sites and tourist attractions in
Austin. The limestone height stands at 775 ft above sea level and is considered to be the highest
point within Austin City Limits. It has been a popular sightseeing destination since the mid-19th
century and continues to attract tourists and locals for mountain biking, hiking, and more on the
Mount Bonnel hiking trail. In fact, it’s a favorite for mountain bikers and a Mount Bonell hike is
on the bucket list of many tourists. Mount Bonnell also known as Covert Park belongs, next to other
parks such as Mueller Lake Park and Zilker Park, to the best parks in Austin.

Visit Mt. Bonnell Austin TX and Covert Park at Mount Bonnell trails and enjoy the beauty of the
Austin skyline. If you want to learn more, you can also buy one of many topographic maps with
elevation data and Austin TX Mount Bonnell directions. So, when tourists arrive and ask: Are there
mountains in Austin, Texas? You can tell them to get ready for an exciting walk on the Mt Bonell
stairs to the top. While you’re visiting Bonnell Austin, don’t forget to take in [Circuit of

to see the rural countryside of Central Texas with its rugged hills and native vegetation.

If you’re looking for accommodation, you’ll be spoilt for choice, from family hotels to five star
hotels in Austin. [Hotel Saint Cecilia][26] in Austin and [The Loren at Lady Bird Lake][27] both

Silvio Bellini

[Victor Huberson]

Victor Huberson

Investor at Partech

01.

## Connect to Claude and other AI tools

Extract custom insights, like buyer lists or valuation sentiment, via MCP or the native AI chatbot.
Trained directly on our dataset.

[Connect to MCP][10]

Extremely useful tool. I love the sector classification, which is much more updated and relevant to
tech investors vs. other tools in the market. It saves a lot of time!

[Constanza Diaz]

Constanza Diaz

Investor at Octopus Ventures

[Connect to Claude and other AI tools]
02.

## Investment-Grade Valuation Data

You can trust the numbers. Our public comps are powered by FactSet and Morningstar, while deal data
is sourced through a proprietary investment banking research. Benchmark 50+ various metrics like
EV/NTM revenue, EV/Gross Profit, rule of 40, Bessemer's rule of X, revenue per employee, or R&D to
sales ratio.

[See more on data][11]

Extremely useful tool. I love the sector classification, which is much more updated and relevant to
tech investors vs. other tools in the market. It saves a lot of time!

[Constanza Diaz]

Constanza Diaz

Investor at Octopus Ventures

[Investment-Grade Valuation Data]
03.

## Sector Classification Built For Digital Age

We split comps into 220+ granular categories across all industry verticals, with a special emphasis
on digital ecosystems. You can filter through tech themes like vertical AI applications or IoT as
well as compare to offline sectors like airlines or logistics.

[See more on sectors][12]

Multiples is an absolute game-changer and saved me countless hours of analysis. User-friendly UI,
it's just incredibly easy to focus on metrics that matter the most.

[Adam Hajer]

Adam Hajer

Investor at Russmedia

[Sector Classification Built For Digital Age]
04.

Use our white-label API to seamlessly integrate Multiples data within your existing Sheets or Excel
workflows, or build your own financial SaaS products powered by our data - significantly cheaper
(and faster!) than legacy data providers.

[See API documentation][13]

With the most comprehensive tech-first company taxonomy I've seen for public markets, Multiples.vc
allowed us to bring the data to life for the State of European Tech Report readers.

[Hanna-Stina Sonts]

Hanna-Stina Sonts

VP at Atomico

[Automate Valuation Workflows With API]

## Finding Valuation Multiples
## Doesn't Need To Be Painful

Our mission: to deliver institutional-quality valuation data through a modern UI at a fraction of
the cost of major providers.

### AI Analyst

Native AI copilot continously trained on our dataset, so you can extract custom insights in seconds.

### Consensus Estimates

Access metrics like NTM Revenue or 2027E EBITDA, powered by FactSet, harmonized by us.

### Verified Deal Data

Get M&A and VC round valuation data with over 27% more deal multiples compared to MergerMarket.

### Historical Time Series Data

Track valuation trends with 10 years of monthly historical data across all public companies.

### Connect to Claude and other AI tools

Use [MCP][14] to extract insights from our dataset without leaving Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI
tools.

### Valuations, Automated

Automate your Google Sheets and Excel valuation workflows, or build your own tools using our
[API][15].

Under our registered brand **Rinofix**, we produce high-quality external nasal splints designed for
superior nasal stabilization. Based in Istanbul, we combine 17+ years of expertise with continuous
R&D to provide world-class solutions for plastic surgeons and ENT specialists.

**Rinofix External Nasal Splint** is the trusted choice for rhinoplasty, septoplasty, trauma
recovery, and nasal fractures, offering a reliable and comfortable postoperative solution.

**Key Features of Rinofix:**
* **Superior Patient Comfort:** Lightweight and breathable structure for long-term wear.
* **Maximum Stabilization:** Maintains the nasal structure in the desired position with strong
  fixing properties.
* **Biocompatible & Skin-Friendly:** Minimized allergy risk with medical-grade, skin-friendly
  materials.
* **Easy Application:** Designed for clinical efficiency and high patient satisfaction.

With a commitment to quality-oriented production, Rinomed has become a leading brand trusted by top
surgeons. Our mission is simple: to make the post-surgical recovery process safer, more comfortable,

# Welcome to Soluvos Medical

Soluvos Medical specialised in high quality products for airway management, OR- and office-based
treatments in the field of Ear, Nose, and Throat (ENT) and Laryngology. Its focus is on innovative
ENT treatments performed under local anaesthesia to reduce pain & recovery time for the patient and
improve quality of life. Soluvos Medical collaborates with mostly long existing family-owned
manufacturers with a great reputation on quality and service.

Soluvos Medical is a privately-owned company with extensive knowledge and expertise in the medical
field of ENT. The company has efficient logistics and excellent service for customers throughout
many European countries. Find out more about us.

Let us meet and show how we can serve you best with the following companies.

 

**Soluvos Medical Ltd. is ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 14001:2015 certified**

 

 

### Laryngology

Soluvos Medical offers a wide variety of laryngology products, ao Renú Voice, Montgomery Thyroplasty
Implants, Restech and Trachospray from manufacturers: Cytophil, Boston Medical, Restech from the USA
and Medspray Anesthesia from NL.
**Renú Voice is the In-Label use product for vocal fold augmentation.**

### Laser

Soluvos Medical offers the full ENT surgical laser line, including the new TruBlue Pro Blue light
laser, Diode, CO2  laser of A.R.C. Laser from Nürnberg, Germany.  We are pleased to confirm that we
are the sales partner in the BeNeLux, Italy, Norway, Denmark, Sweden, some hospitals in Finland and
also in the UK for Sales, Service & Consumables.  We cover also all of the UK.  Please contact us
for any of your laser requirements.

### Head & Neck

Soluvos Medical offers for our Head and Neck line the Montgomery products, including Safe T Tubes
and Pharyngeal tubes of Boston Medical Products, COOK Blood Flow Monitoring for reconstructive
surgery both from the USA and DilaTlaX balloon dilation from Bencorpp, Italy.

### Otology

Soluvos Medical offers the Otology line, which includes silicone sheetings and ventilation tubes of
bess Medizintechnik from Berlin, Germany and the COOK medical Biodesign Otologic Repair Graft.

### A.R.C. Lasers in UK

Soluvos Medical is delighted to announce that we are the **UK Responsible Persons with the MHRA for
A.R.C. Lasers. **We offer the following lasers Nuvolas, FOX, TruBlue, Clas CO2 lasers with their
respected fibers. **NOTE**: Our products can also be found on the **NHS Supply Chain: Lot 4 –
Medical Lasers and all Related Accessories and Services**.

### Rhinology and Maxillofacial

Soluvos Medical offers the rhinology products which includes splints and silicone sheetings of bess
Medizintechnik from Berlin, Germany, Boston Medical Products USA, Sialendoscopy line and the
Biodesign Duralgraft of COOK medical  from the USA and Velnez fragmented nose tampons of Datt
Mediproducts from India.

### Training & Maintenance

Our product training sessions help you use our systems safely, effectively, and with confidence. In
addition, we offer hands-on workshops where you can learn new techniques, exchange experiences, and
further refine your skills.

Ensuring long-term and reliable performance of your equipment, we provide both preventive and
full-service maintenance for lasers.

# Welcome to Soluvos Medical

Soluvos Medical specialised in high quality products for airway management, OR- and office-based
treatments in the field of Ear, Nose, and Throat (ENT) and Laryngology. Its focus is on innovative
ENT treatments performed under local anaesthesia to reduce pain & recovery time for the patient and
improve quality of life. Soluvos Medical collaborates with mostly long existing family-owned
manufacturers with a great reputation on quality and service.

Soluvos Medical is a privately-owned company with extensive knowledge and expertise in the medical
field of ENT. The company has efficient logistics and excellent service for customers throughout
many European countries. Find out more about us.

Let us meet and show how we can serve you best with the following companies.

 

**Soluvos Medical Ltd. is ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 14001:2015 certified**

 

 

### Laryngology

Soluvos Medical offers a wide variety of laryngology products, ao Renú Voice, Montgomery Thyroplasty
Implants, Restech and Trachospray from manufacturers: Cytophil, Boston Medical, Restech from the USA
and Medspray Anesthesia from NL.
**Renú Voice is the In-Label use product for vocal fold augmentation.**

### Laser

Soluvos Medical offers the full ENT surgical laser line, including the new TruBlue Pro Blue light
laser, Diode, CO2  laser of A.R.C. Laser from Nürnberg, Germany.  We are pleased to confirm that we
are the sales partner in the BeNeLux, Italy, Norway, Denmark, Sweden, some hospitals in Finland and
also in the UK for Sales, Service & Consumables.  We cover also all of the UK.  Please contact us
for any of your laser requirements.

### Head & Neck

Soluvos Medical offers for our Head and Neck line the Montgomery products, including Safe T Tubes
and Pharyngeal tubes of Boston Medical Products, COOK Blood Flow Monitoring for reconstructive
surgery both from the USA and DilaTlaX balloon dilation from Bencorpp, Italy.

### Otology

Soluvos Medical offers the Otology line, which includes silicone sheetings and ventilation tubes of
bess Medizintechnik from Berlin, Germany and the COOK medical Biodesign Otologic Repair Graft.

### A.R.C. Lasers in UK

Soluvos Medical is delighted to announce that we are the **UK Responsible Persons with the MHRA for
A.R.C. Lasers. **We offer the following lasers Nuvolas, FOX, TruBlue, Clas CO2 lasers with their
respected fibers. **NOTE**: Our products can also be found on the **NHS Supply Chain: Lot 4 –
Medical Lasers and all Related Accessories and Services**.

### Rhinology and Maxillofacial

Soluvos Medical offers the rhinology products which includes splints and silicone sheetings of bess
Medizintechnik from Berlin, Germany, Boston Medical Products USA, Sialendoscopy line and the
Biodesign Duralgraft of COOK medical  from the USA and Velnez fragmented nose tampons of Datt
Mediproducts from India.

### Training & Maintenance

Our product training sessions help you use our systems safely, effectively, and with confidence. In
addition, we offer hands-on workshops where you can learn new techniques, exchange experiences, and
further refine your skills.

Ensuring long-term and reliable performance of your equipment, we provide both preventive and
full-service maintenance for lasers.
